pages.text: Spawns Anadia in nearby water. Stops when there are $(ritual:animal_harvest/fish_count) or more fish nearby.
$(standing_stones) As a $(l:rituals/tiers)$(bold)tier III$() ritual, $(l:rituals/ritual_animal_harvest#multiblock)3 standing stones are required to begin$(). Please see later pages of this entry.
The ritual requires three $(l:rituals/standing_stones)standing stones$() of runestone or runed obsidian.

pages.title: Ritual Specifics
pages.text: $(bold)Duration:$() The ritual lasts for $(ritual:animal_harvest/SECONDS/duration) seconds.$(br2)$(bold)Size:$() Ritual area extends $(ritual:animal_harvest/radius_x) and $(ritual:animal_harvest/radius_z) blocks from the center, and vertically by $(ritual:animal_harvest/radius_y) blocks.
